items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: He loved Dave Tuft and Jimmy Tough McPartland. They were at our home all the time

ctx.x: When I say we are all sick, I think that I was very much influenced and frightened by my father who was an athletic man, and thought it was a thought it was a sin to drink sin to destroy oneself. He loved Dave Tuft and Jimmy Tough McPartland. They were at our home all the time, but he
felt very badly, he could not condone their drinking habits. They were not addicts ever. Never got into that. But a very interesting point, that our era had none of that.
